# Textarea

```ts
import { Textarea } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Multi-line text entry — comments, descriptions, feedback, notes. Use it when the answer can run to a sentence or more; for a short single value (a name, a search), use TextInput. For a read-only value, use Field.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Label text above the field (renders an InputLabel, wired via htmlFor). |
| `showLabelInfo` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the label's 16px info icon. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required: appends the label's "(required)" suffix and sets the native required attribute. |
| `helperText` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Helper text below the field (renders a HelperString, wired via aria-describedby). |
| `status` | `'default' \| 'success' \| 'error'` | `'default'` | Validation state: tints the field and the helper with the success/error tokens and sets aria-invalid on error. |
| `maxLength` | `number` | — | Character limit — sets the native maxLength and shows the helper counter ("0/250"). |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Visible lines before the field scrolls. People can drag the corner to make it taller (vertical resize only). |

Also accepts all `React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<Textarea label="Comments" placeholder="Add a comment" />
<Textarea label="Description" required helperText="Shown on the device page" maxLength={250} />
<Textarea label="Notes" rows={6} />
<Textarea label="Feedback" status="error" helperText="Tell us a little more" />
<Textarea label="Feedback" status="success" helperText="Thanks — saved" />
<Textarea label="Reason" disabled defaultValue="Locked by your admin" />
```

## Accessibility

- The label is a real <label for>, so clicking it focuses the field and screen readers announce it. Without a visible label, pass aria-label.
- Helper text and the counter are linked with aria-describedby, so they're read after the label.
- Error sets aria-invalid; the error is shown by color and the helper's icon and text — write the helper so it says what to fix.
- required sets the native attribute and shows "(required)".

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use for answers that can run to a sentence or more | Use for a single short value — that's TextInput |
| Show a counter when there's a limit | Cut people off with no warning |
| Say what to fix in the error helper | Show "Invalid" alone |
| Size rows to the expected answer | Make a one-line box for long answers |
